646: static int idma_validate(const struct idma_experiment *e)
647: {
648: 	if (PAGE_SIZE != SZ_4K)
649: 		return -EOPNOTSUPP;
650: 	if (e->abi_version != IDMA_EXPERIMENT_ABI || e->struct_size != sizeof(*e))
651: 		return -EPROTO;

655: 	    !e->aggressor_pages || e->aggressor_pages > IDMA_MAX_PAGES ||
